04 / ABOUT THIS ATLAS

Built for a clearer
engineering comparison.

The atlas brings opening geometry, retained strength and manufacturing payback into one explorable research resource. SpurAtlas checks case compatibility, ranks openings and exports reproducible design records. This release includes ten pre-specified test layouts, the wider nine-tooth-count research index, nine material options and two carbon case studies. Earlier development results, source-corrected material calculations and separate geometry tests retain their own evidence labels.
